# ADS-B Exchange tar1090 aircraft marker artwork and mappings

Source: https://github.com/ADSBexchange/tar1090/blob/master/html/markers.js
Repository: https://github.com/ADSBexchange/tar1090
Source marker-file Git blob SHA: cecc076a15ea202446b7fce34704a451d87dcb49

Original tar1090 marker code and artwork: GPL version 2 or later, see GPL-2.0.txt
Adaptation in TAK Map: extraction of unmodified SVG path geometry; dynamic color, styling and marker placement are TAK Map additions.
A selection of 30 upstream silhouettes is included in this package, not the complete 93-shape upstream set. The 376 upstream ICAO type designator mappings are included. Some upstream mappings intentionally share silhouettes; for shapes not yet bundled TAK Map uses a visible category-family fallback.

Specific third-party attribution: C-130 silhouette by Peter Lowden, CC BY 4.0; source credit: https://discussions.flightaware.com/ads-b-flight-tracking-f21/some-custom-svg-plane-icons-t37783.html . License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ .
Other upstream comments/credits remain with the upstream source. No Progress/Kendo UI assets or proprietary assets are copied.
